gpu_prefilter_arithmetic.evidence: GPU bicubic contaminated exact 1280x720->960x540 case; same storage-image/barrier path with bilinear downsample and libswscale reference resize were clean

temporal_feedback.evidence: fixed exact case was clean in history/recurrent off/off, on/off, off/on, and on/on arms

geometry.evidence: fixed source==model, source>model, and source<model traces record source/model/output grids and scale factors

jitter.evidence: production prepass jitter, jitter-off, and full-reset oracle were visually clean

rgb10_vs_fp16_model_carrier.reason: The production source/model descriptors are RGB10/A2 and an in-process RGBA16F carrier swap would require broad descriptor/resource changes outside the smallest fix. The captured native stage-A data was nevertheless re-evaluated with float32 and simulated RGB10 quantization; the carrier residual had RMSE 0.0001482 and max error 0.0004830. Its 2–32px band metrics are reported for matched comparison but are not treated as causal evidence without a GPU carrier A/B.
rgb10_vs_fp16_model_carrier.evidence: precision_order_ablation.json; FP16_FP8 boundary diagnostic and CPU float resize reference were clean
rgb10_vs_fp16_model_carrier.limitation: This is a deterministic numerical ablation, not a GPU RGBA16F resource substitution.

transform_ordering.evidence: precision_order_ablation.json compares transform-before-resolve with resolve-before-transform using a high-precision float carrier derived from the native stage-A readback; ordering is numerically distinguishable (RMSE 0.0014204, max error 0.09435). The 2–32px band metrics are emitted for comparison but are not sufficient to identify the causal boundary.
transform_ordering.limitation: An independent GPU resolve-before-transform arm remains outside the current descriptor contract; the production trace still verifies transform-before-resolve.
